intro.text: An acquaintance of Adolin Kholin's from Highprince Aladar's warcamp.

items.text: On the day of Adolin's duel with Brightlord Resi, Toral met him at a winehouse with friends. When Adolin asked about Sadeas, Toral explained why the highprince hadn't moved against Dalinar, and was puzzled when Adolin defended his father. His parting remark, that people were saying Dalinar should abdicate, weighed on Adolin.

appearance.text: A keen young lighteyed man who dresses fashionably.

personality.text: He has refined taste, likes wine, understands politics and speaks intelligently.
